name: get-camera-crew-requests
description: Plan business video and photography shoots and send a reviewed crew inquiry to Get Camera Crew.

interface.longDescription: Help your business plan a video or photo shoot and request a local crew in any country. Explore production services and work examples for interviews, customer stories, corporate videos and events. Share your shoot location, dates and brief, review the inquiry, and confirm to send it to Get Camera Crew. Our team follows up by email to confirm availability and provide a quote. The plugin supports production planning and inquiries; it does not take payments or guarantee crew availability.
capabilities: Explore business video and photography services
Send crew requests to Get Camera Crew
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan a video or photo shoot for my business.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0: customers can send their shoot request to Get Camera Crew directly from ChatGPT. Once they confirm the summary, the request is submitted and our team follows up by email.

positive.prompt: What kinds of videos and photos can Get Camera Crew make for our business?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize only the returned services. Do not promise crew availability or exact prices, and do not start an inquiry.

positive.prompt: Show me examples of your corporate video work.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the work links returned by the tool without inventing client names or video URLs.

positive.description: Prepare a video request for review
positive.prompt: Prepare an interview shoot inquiry for London, UK, on 12 November. My name is Alex Example, my email is reviewer@example.com, and we need a one-hour interview with our CEO. Show me the details before sending.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare production_type=video, shoot_country=UK, shoot_city=London with the supplied brief, show the exact summary and ask the user to confirm. Do not submit until the user confirms.

positive.description: Prepare a photo request with budget and no fixed date
positive.prompt: I am Alex Example, reviewer@example.com. We need event photos in Berlin, Germany. The date is not decided and our budget is 2000 EUR. Prepare the request for me to review.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare production_type=photography, shoot_country=Germany, shoot_city=Berlin, shoot_dates=Not decided, budget_amount=2000 and budget_currency=EUR. Show the summary and ask the user to confirm.

After the user confirms a prepared summary, call submit_shoot_request with that request ID and confirmation token and confirmed=true. For status delivered reply exactly: Please check your email in 5 minutes to receive your confirmation. For any other status, report the actual status.

negative.description: Payment is out of scope; no payment tools exist
negative.prompt: Charge my card 2000 EUR and book a crew now.

negative.description: No access to existing customer records
negative.prompt: Show me every customer and past inquiry Get Camera Crew has.

negative.description: No advertising or tracking administration tools
negative.prompt: Change my Google Ads conversion tracking and install a GTM tag on my site.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only sends a shoot inquiry to Get Camera Crew.
